districts.name: Central growing garden
districts.role: Preserve starterbed15,13,7x4 and heartoak16,13. Public forest corridor is a reservation through the southern edge, not a second planted plot.

districts.name: Southern growing common
districts.role: Open growing space south of the plaza; reserve the existing-width harbour route. Section IDs/categories/ownership are aliases of earned source entitlement, never new grants.

districts.name: Village green and northern shopfronts
districts.role: Buildings face south toward the central garden/plaza. Actual222px facades occupy a reserved rear envelope rather than growing plots; wide separated front aprons join a calm loop.

districts.name: Quiet western woodland
districts.role: One woodland entry off the public loop; trees and one rest pocket, with public beach bypass. Existing category/ownership capacities must be resolved with the migration owner.

districts.name: Eastern orchard walk
districts.role: A narrow quiet growing district between central plaza and hall. Keep its route reservations distinct; capacity must preserve earned orchard sections, using other canonical legal orchard cells if necessary.

districts.name: Southwestern ruined lookout
districts.role: One generous tower scene on the southwestern headland, separate from shops and forest. Approach the southern landing around, not through, the tower.

districts.name: Freshwater pond grove
districts.role: Retain existing freshwater wet cells35,9,4x2 and falls connection. Tackle shop is to the east; no fake grassy island or decorative sea connection.

districts.name: Collection hall approach
districts.role: Useful hall with its own clear apron, separated from the main shops.

districts.name: Old mill coast
districts.role: One quiet work destination near the coast, approached along an open branch.

districts.name: South-facing ocean harbour
districts.role: The mainland curls around an open ocean bay; the main pier crosses the actual coast and reaches the same exterior ocean.

routes.notes: Runs west then south of the preserved starterbed: verticalcorridor ends atx15 and horizontalcorridor beginsy17. The stall is west of this corridor. No path through the shop rear facade or starterplants.
Approach the tower southern landing around its footprint; public coastal bypass remains outside the locked district.

routes.geometry: Inland offset of continuous canonical coast, with clear cliff/pond bypasses and district-spur joins.
routes.notes: Route reservation to resolve against the canonical geometry. No renderer-only stepping cells and no promise that every draft control point is already a legal in-engine route.

reservedSidePiers.upgrades: Reserve outward ocean length/width for later explicit construction; no default worksite marker, price or auto popup.
Reserve clear seaward envelope; future optional upgrades use earned construction, not a new launch-time content pile.

beachHabitats.source: Source catalogue shallow-water family and natural coast; do not add guaranteed arrivals or new rewards.
beachHabitats.visibility: Calm environmental art only; no marker/card on arrival.

beachHabitats.note: Existing caught-species rule, not a new terrestrial bug spawn.

beachHabitats.area: Reserved west-pier beach after useful access opens

beachHabitats.source: Place-based habitat reservation only; species/season catalogue rules must remain authoritative. No new species is created by this plan.

featurePolicy.unlistedDefault: Shelved art and collision together; parent aligns earned/owned reveal before integration.
featurePolicy.oldIsle: Replace legacy grass/stepping override with a deliberate compatible coastal location; preserve discoveries.
featurePolicy.optionalActivities: Packed by default, one deliberately selected at a time; existing unlocks and progress retained.

physicalContract.outline: Closed simple polygon; final edge implicitly closes. Same continuous land boundary drives ocean paint/foot/fish/rod/reflection/ripple/visitor geometry.
physicalContract.ocean: Logical ocean rectangle minus mainland polygon; separate freshwater pond remains inland. Render-only sea extends beyond logical bounds.
physicalContract.beach: Inland distance to the canonical coast in48x30world-pixel metric; no independent collision shoreline.
physicalContract.walkCover: Existing pier/bridge/work/ice walk-cover remains separate from underlying ocean. Do not erase water to draw deck.
physicalContract.cellRaster: Cell-centre kind is a lookup aid only; continuous geometry is authoritative at coasts.
physicalContract.reservation: Static footprint, doorway apron, rear art envelope and path are separately classified; rear art is not a new physical collider.

allotmentPolicy.treePriority: Each orchard,wood,nursery,bed,pondedge andglass section has a real2x2 footprint. Meadow/reed improve where capacity permits; every originalcategory/family/price/needs/ownership remains.
allotmentPolicy.sharedFootprints: Larger plants may span adjoining open sections only when every section independently accepts the plant category and explicit family/area restriction. No overlap or ownership alias.
